original_goal: Gather five related but distinct designs: generic artifact lineage, workitem scheduling, attention lanes, festival-resident workitem lifecycle, and festival project binding with worktree and stack automation.
delivered: The festival-lifecycle slice shipped through WF0001: sweep, rail residency, promotion, demotion, doctor checks, Fest navigation, and app cards.
missing: Board and lane TUI behavior, WIP nudges, and app support did not ship.
Camp-owned scheduling is absent and conflicts with the newer Fest/Obey direction.
Project binding and stacks remain a research skeleton: one project path and manual foundations exist, but not plural projects, automatic worktrees and links, cleanup, or stacks.
stale_assumptions: The design predates the Fest/Obey split of scheduling ownership, so its camp-owned scheduling premise no longer holds.
open_decisions: Whether the unshipped slices stay one umbrella workitem or split by owner.
Where scheduling belongs now that camp is not the owner.
confidence_notes: high for delivered and current behavior; medium for the unshipped project-binding scope, which was read from the research skeleton rather than from code
